name: Italy (IRPEF + Lazio + Roma Capitale)
kernel_gaps: Out in whole units (Italy reports cents; own JSON writer, kernel Country rounds to euros)
ratio truncated to four decimals (TUIR art. 13 c. 6)
one percentage of the whole income chosen by income band (L. 207/2024 c. 4): not a Schedule
local surtax due only if the central net tax is positive (D.Lgs. 446/1997 art. 50 c. 2)
benefit set by an equivalence-scale income test (ISEE, assegno unico)

validation.notes: IRPEF, INPS and assegno unico within 0.13 EUR on the OECD's wages rounded to the euro; all 14 misses are SLT and take-home pay: the OECD omits Lazio's 2025 reliefs (L.R. 22/2024 art. 2 cc. 2-3), F1

validation.referee: AdE circolare 4/E 2025 worked examples (cuneo sum, examples 1-3)
OECD TW 2025 component lines at the OECD's own wages (CGITLETC S100, S67; spouse credit M100_0; BTC S100, S67)
validation.notes: lorda and spouse credit to the cent; BTC 4 cents lower by the statute's four-decimal rule (F2)

headline: Italy's 2025 income tax in Lean matches the OECD to the cent except for Lazio's 2025 surtax reliefs, which the OECD omits; a 1-euro raise near 8,500 costs 300 euro, and a 99-euro pension contribution can save 171.
